title: Static Eight Boat Follicle and Seeded Star Anise Fruit
description: One wholly newly authored low-poly dry star-anise-like aggregate fruit at approximately natural scale. Eight unequal swollen boat-shaped woody follicles radiate from a low continuous central axis. Every follicle has finite closed shell thickness, a real lengthwise upper opening, an enclosed floor and one complete compressed ovoid seed seated inside. The outer silhouette, longitudinal cavities and seed placements are newly drawn, not a lotus seedhead with extra holes, rearranged pea valves, extracted old fruit pieces or a recoloured flower. One whole static botanical prop, zero scenes, three opaque solid PBR roles. This is a stylized exterior study, not exact species identification or a way to distinguish edible and poisonous Illicium species; no culinary, nutritional, medicinal, growth or physical-stability claims. No rig, animation or interaction made or verified.
